platform: Windows Chrome through connected browser UI
order: C01 A/B, C02 B/A, then alternate by case number
personalization: Existing account settings retained; personalization was not independently disabled or controlled. No existing conversation was opened as source data.
data: Only the authored synthetic input column; expected_points/rubric not sent to Gemini.
